approval_exact_phrase: Approve protocol v1.3 pre-freeze package and proceed to D04 freeze.
change_control: Any post-freeze change to a bound artifact requires a dated deviation record, impact assessment, accountable-author approval, and a new package version/checksum.
maximum_novelty_statement: No substantively duplicative framework was identified within the predeclared open scholarly indexes, repositories, and citation networks searched through the stated cutoff date.
prohibited_claims: Developmental query-control counts are systematic or PRISMA counts.
The framework is empirically validated in organizations.
The framework measures validated human cognitive load.
